Ramesh Giri Deceased and Another ........ Appellants
v.
Venkateshwar Bhagwan Ramanuj Bhagwan 
and Others ........Respondents
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. B.D. Pande, Advocate for the 
appellants.
Mr. Nikhil Singhal, Advocate for the 
respondent nos. 2/1 and 5.
Heard on Amendment Application, IA 
No.2 of 2026
In this appeal, the respondent no.1 was 
represented through Shesh Narayan 
Acharya, who is otherwise respondent no.2 
also. Since the respondent no.2 had already 
died, the appellant proposes to correct the 
description of respondent no.1 for that 
purpose. 
The amendment application is allowed.
Let the amended memo of parties be 
filed within a week. 
List this matter on 30.07.2026, under 
the caption of Final Hearing.
In the meantime, paper books be 
prepared and provided to learned counsel for 
the parties, as per Rules. 
 (Ravindra Maithani J.) 
19.06.2026
